title.narrative: Securing Peace and Promoting Prosperity in Karamoja Activity

description.narrative: USAID's Securing Peace and Promoting Prosperity in Karamoja Activity will use a people-to-people approach that brings groups together across divisions to address underlying social, economic, ecological, and governance issues at risk of fueling conflict in Karamoja
